description.text: Introduction: We are committed to train and educate senior engineering technicians to master the basic theory and knowledge of engineering mechanics, fluid mechanics, rock mechanics and structural design, who have the ability to work on the planning, designing, scientific developing, constructing and managing of civil engineering projects in house-building engineering, highways and city roads engineering, bridge engineering, tunnel and underground engineering and airfield engineering. Research: Because of its great strength, this discipline has been authorized to award both the master's and doctor's degrees in solid mechanics and to award the master's degree in structural engineering. Its primary researches are involved in elastic wave and its application in earthquake engineering & shock structure engineering, elastic-plastic fractural mechanics and its elastic deformation and variation method, optimum structuring and theory of construction reliability and its application, reinforced concrete structure, steel structure, structural emulation system and so on. The suitable career fields for the graduates: Most of the graduates will choose the Building Industry Head Corporation of China and construction enterprises of civil engineering, architectural designing research institute, universities and colleges, urban construction department and real estate development agency in some of the coastal cities. Core classes: theoretical mechanics, material mechanics, structural mechanics, rock mechanics, fluid mechanics, concrete structure, masonry structure, steel structure, house architecture, construction technology of civil engineering, construction budget of civil engineering, organization and management of engineering items, survey of civil engineering, architectural Auto CAD, PKPM structure CAD, shock structure designing, bridge structure and track survey & designing

duration.text: The Civil Engineering at Harbin Engineering University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school

requirements.text: 1.Graduates of Senior High School or above 2.Over 18 years old, in good health
